_comment: Hand-maintained content of the course site. scripts/build-site.ps1 merges it with the course files (data/courseN.md) into site/data.json. The 'go further' cards of the Resources page are NOT listed here: they are generated from the References section of each course file.

objectives.title: Interpretability
objectives.text: Understand how the acquisition of transcriptomics data constrains the way we analyse those data and the way we interpret the results.

objectives.title: Systems thinking
objectives.text: Think in systems: connect concepts as graphs, with the mind map and the Biolink activity.

objectives.title: Reproducibility
objectives.text: Produce analyses that another person can rerun and obtain the same numbers, through the practical sessions.

objectives.title: Provenance, transparency and collaborative translational science
objectives.text: Record where data and results come from, work in the open, and collaborate with shared tooling such as GitHub.
